name: The Rumormonger
summary: Having done a service for the gnomes, Kravel Koalbeard now wants to do the goblins a favor. He has heard that Nazz Steamboil, the goblin racer pilot, once went by another name, and wonders whether it is a secret worth money. He sends you to Krazek of Booty Bay, who would know.

sections.title: A Name Worth Asking About
sections.body: Kravel Koalbeard says the goblins are next in line for a favor. Nazz Steamboil, the goblin racer pilot, once went by another name, he hears, and Kravel wonders why it changed, whether it hides a secret, and whether Nazz cares to keep it hidden. The one who would know the truth, Kravel says, is Krazek, down at the southern tip of Stranglethorn in Booty Bay. Useful information might turn a profit. Look for Krazek at the Salty Sailor Tavern.

sections.title: Krazek's Answer
sections.body: Krazek knows of Nazz Steamboil as a racer pilot out on the Shimmering Flats. Krazek says something might be found out, but warns it will be neither easy, nor fast, nor cheap.

faq.answer: Kravel Koalbeard, a dwarf at the Mirage Raceway, out on the Shimmering Flats, sends you.

faq.q: Why is Kravel interested in Nazz Steamboil?
faq.answer: Kravel heard that the goblin racer pilot did not always use that name. He wonders whether it is a secret, and whether Nazz values it enough to make it profitable.
Krazek is at the Salty Sailor Tavern, in Booty Bay at the southern tip of Stranglethorn.
It follows Delivery to the Gnomes, the service done for the gnomes.
